preconditions.description: Number of vertices is between 2 and 200,000.
Number of edges is between n-1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n and ai != bi and 1 <= ci <= 10**4 for ai, bi, ci in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge has valid vertices and flow volume.

postconditions.expression: all(di in {0, 1} for di in output)
all(sum(ci for ai, bi, ci in edges if di == 0 and (ai == v or bi == v)) == sum(ci for ai, bi, ci in edges if di == 1 and (ai == v or bi == v)) for v in range(2, n))
postconditions.description: For each vertex v (1 < v < n), the sum of incoming flows equals the sum of outgoing flows.

postconditions.expression: all(di == 1 for ai, bi, ci in edges if ai == 1)
not any(all(di == 0 for ai, bi, ci in edges if ai == v or bi == v) for v in range(1, n+1))
postconditions.description: The obtained directed graph does not have cycles.
